content.short: KAST is a stablecoin money app with USD and EU IBAN accounts, Visa cards, yield and global payouts.
content.description: KAST is a stablecoin money app that lets people store, earn on, move and spend digital dollars anywhere. Users get US and EU virtual accounts with IBAN and routing details, Visa cards in several tiers, yield vaults through KAST Earn, and global payouts and remittances. They can deposit USDC and USDT or swap in SOL, ETH and BTC across networks including Solana and Ethereum, then spend with cards that convert stablecoins to fiat at checkout. Available in more than 170 countries and backed by an 80 million dollar Series A, KAST targets freelancers, remote workers and global earners who want borderless spending built on stablecoins.
